scope: Original static vegetation and wooden props, inspired by general illustrated RPG construction rules

provenance.method: Measured private inventory and visual inspection of 21 contact sheets, plus native environment/item atlases

lighting.status: chosen consistent production rule; references have exceptions

perspective.rule: Show a shallow top surface and taller front; no isometric diamond axes

observations: Environment foliage uses overlapping pointed leaf clusters over a continuous dark mass.
Warm wood is separated into broad value planes with sparse directional grain and dark joinery.
One-pixel colored contours are common; deep overlap creases can be thicker.
Characters use exaggerated heads, compact torsos, narrow limbs, and high facial contrast.
Large atlases contain many object palettes; whole-atlas color counts are not per-object budgets.
Seasonal environment variants retain geometry while changing material ramps.
Technical paint masks, localized interfaces, scenery, effects and actors require separate treatment.
inferences: Use 4-6 opaque shades per material, reserving brightest values for selected upper-left clusters.
Maintain 2-5 connected pixels in small leaf highlights, longer mass clusters below them.
Keep strong contrast at silhouette, overlaps, rim and focal details; reduce contrast in grain.
conflicts: Some skies and light effects contain smooth gradients or partial alpha; isolated prop profile deliberately excludes these.
Some actors use nearly black outlines while environment foliage uses dark material colors.
A fixed upper-left light is a production choice, not a universal fact about every reference.

materials.foliage: Plan unequal lobes, overlap from back to front, use pointed or stepped leaf wedges; avoid independent outlined circles and random dots.
materials.wood: Shade the cylinder or trunk first; use interrupted vertical grain, broaden roots, and reserve dark pixels for recesses.
materials.metal: Use a compact cool ramp, a narrow highlight and a darker underside; keep bands curved with the vessel.
materials.stone: Use unequal angular masses and short broken seams; unimplemented by the preset generator.
materials.cloth: Use broad planes and a few directional folds; unimplemented by the preset generator.

quality.verdict: Requires actual image viewing; metrics are warnings, not artistic proof
